0218b323c782.name: Rehati
0218b323c782.plain: In your Psychic phase, this model can try to manifest one extra psychic power.

067795f3ab70.name: Seeded Strategy
067795f3ab70.plain: Blessing: when manifested, pick one of your CULT OF SCHEMING CORE units within 24" of this psyker. For the rest of the turn, it is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

0912840d8ce1.name: Perfidious Tome
0912840d8ce1.plain: In each of your Command phases, the bearer can read the tome: roll one D6, and on a 4+ you gain 1 Command point, but on a 1 your opponent gains 1. It can only do this while it is on the battlefield.

097a7f2227bb.name: Desecration of Worlds
097a7f2227bb.plain: Malediction: one enemy unit within 24" of this PSYKER that it can see risks mortal wounds when it makes a Normal Move, Advances, Falls Back or charges. Until your next Psychic phase starts, every time that unit Advances, Falls Back, makes a Normal Move or makes a charge move, you roll one D6 per model in it, and the unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 6 rolled.

0b5ce6018866.name: Airborne Predator
0b5ce6018866.plain: When you declare a charge with this model, only AIRCRAFT units can be its targets. This model can only be targeted by a charge from a unit that can FLY. This model can only fight if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. An enemy unit can only make melee attacks against this model if it can FLY.

0e1fbd066566.name: Inferno Bolts
0e1fbd066566.plain: Before the battle, upgrade one weapon on a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model from your army to fire inferno bolt rounds, changing its AP characteristic to -2. The weapon must be a heavy bolter, twin heavy bolter, combi-bolter, combi-melta or combi-flamer the model has. For a combi-melta or combi-flamer, change only the boltgun profile.

0e29b0c11aa6.name: Brayhorn
0e29b0c11aa6.plain: The bearer's unit adds 1 to its Advance and charge rolls.

0ed277cea431.name: Master Misinformator
0ed277cea431.plain: When the first battle round starts, before the first turn, redeploy this WARLORD and up to D3 of your CULT OF DUPLICITY units, other than VEHICLES. Take them off the battlefield, then set them up again using the mission's normal deployment rules.

12af58f5f5ca.name: Warp Reality
12af58f5f5ca.plain: Malediction: when manifested, pick a terrain feature within 24" of this PSYKER that it can see, then pick an enemy unit within 3" of that terrain feature. Until your next Psychic phase starts, halve that unit's Move characteristic, and take 1 off its Advance and charge rolls.

14650a88bc85.name: Hourglass of Manat
14650a88bc85.plain: The first time the bearer is destroyed, it comes back at the end of that phase with D3 wounds remaining. Keep it to one side until then, and set it up as near as possible to where it was and more than 1" from any enemy models.

15a28e1b4d64.name: Metaphysical Focus
15a28e1b4d64.plain: In your Psychic phase, after an ARCANA ASTARTES PSYKER unit from your army has attempted a psychic action: that unit can try to manifest one psychic power this phase.

161fe8b0db11.name: Capering Imps
161fe8b0db11.plain: If this pact succeeds, an enemy unit within 24" of this INFERNAL MASTER that it can see loses cover and can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. You pick the unit, and the effect lasts until your next Command phase starts.

173f082cb861.name: Blessed Transmutations

183deb1fb976.name: Warp Vortex
183deb1fb976.plain:
In your Shooting phase, this model can use as many Vortex Powers as its characteristics table allows. Each time it does, choose one of the powers below that no friendly model has used this turn and resolve it.

Immaterial Flare: pick an enemy unit within 18" of this model that it can see and roll one D6 per model in that unit. The unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 6 rolled.

Turbulent Discharge: find the nearest enemy unit within 18" of this model that it can see and roll one D6. A 2-4 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on it, and a 5+ inflicts 3 mortal wounds on it.

Maelstrom of Madness: for every enemy unit within 9" of this model, roll one D6; on a 2+, the unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Beam of Unreality: pick an enemy unit within 24" of this model that it can see and that has a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more. Roll one D6; subtract 1 if that unit has the AIRCRAFT keyword, and add 1 if it has the TITANIC keyword. A 3-4 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the unit, and a 5+ inflicts D6 mortal wounds on it.

18d4cf0e825d.name: Cabbalistic Rituals
18d4cf0e825d.plain:
Your army is a Cabal of Sorcerers if every unit in it, apart from UNALIGNED units, has the THOUSAND SONS keyword. At the start of your Psychic phase, your army gains Cabal points for each model on the battlefield that has this ability.

During your Psychic phase you can spend those points on Cabbalistic Rituals; every time you do, lower your Cabal point total by the listed cost. Points you have not spent are lost when your Psychic phase ends.

Unless a ritual says otherwise, you can use each Cabbalistic Ritual once in your Psychic phase, and each of your units can gain the benefit of only one of them. Only a unit that has that ability can benefit from a Cabbalistic Ritual.

1d39fbfd0a07.name: Temporal Surge
1d39fbfd0a07.plain: Blessing: one unit within 6" of this PSYKER that is THOUSAND SONS CAVALRY, THOUSAND SONS BEASTS or THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY can make a Normal Move.

1e98c3124faa.name: Unwavering Phalanx
1e98c3124faa.plain: This Stratagem costs 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, otherwise 3CP. In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS RUBRIC MARINES or THOUSAND SONS SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS units is chosen as an attack's target: for the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of each attack made against that unit (to a minimum of 1).

1f30743cd324.name: Risen Rubricae
1f30743cd324.plain: Once per battle, during deployment, when you set up one of your RUBRIC MARINES units: you can place it anywhere on the battlefield as long as it is more than 9" away from both the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

236af48cf2a1.name: Inferno combi-melta
236af48cf2a1.plain: Before choosing targets, pick one or both of the profiles below to attack with. If you pick both, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this weapon this phase.

23efdbf4a6da.name: Mutant Regeneration
23efdbf4a6da.plain: In your Command phase, this model gets back up to D3 lost wounds.

254a5632ab8f.name: Paradigm of Change
254a5632ab8f.plain: Increase this model's Wounds and Attacks characteristics by 1 each.

25733a90948b.name: Daemon Primarch
25733a90948b.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, this model has to be your WARLORD. If several models in your army have a rule like this, one of them has to be your WARLORD.

269296be5f0a.name: Arcane Smokescreen
269296be5f0a.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS SMOKESCREEN units is chosen as an attack's target: for the rest of the phase, every attack made against that unit has 1 subtracted from its hit roll.

28808bd36011.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
28808bd36011.plain: Your WARLORD knows one extra psychic power. If MAGNUS THE RED is your WARLORD, it knows every power from all of the disciplines it has access to.

29829dedb316.name: Herd banner
29829dedb316.plain: You can re-roll any Morale test taken for the bearer's unit.

29e9fe84270d.name: Guided by Fate
29e9fe84270d.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks with anything other than disc blades, an unmodified 6 to hit automatically wounds the target.

2a7e3ddbe713.name: Egleighen's Orrery
2a7e3ddbe713.plain: In your turn, your THOUSAND SONS CORE units near the bearer can ignore modifiers and Damage-reducing abilities when they attack one enemy unit you pick. When each of your Command phases starts, you can pick one enemy unit the bearer can see. If you do, the bearer has this aura until the end of the turn. Fated Doom (Aura): while one of your THOUSAND SONS CORE units is within 6" of the bearer, whenever a model in that unit attacks the picked enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, hit roll and wound roll, and any abilities that would reduce its Damage characteristic.

2dcc33bff91f.name: Paradoxical Chatterfowl
2dcc33bff91f.plain: When the Fight phase starts, roll one D3 to weaken one enemy model within 3" of the bearer until the next Fight phase starts. That model's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics go down by the result, and every Psychic test taken for it has the result subtracted.

2ee628e87851.name: Slow and Purposeful
2ee628e87851.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your ARCANA ASTARTES INFANTRY units makes a Normal Move: until your next turn starts, it counts as having Remained Stationary.

307b417c8e5b.name: Rites of Coalescence
307b417c8e5b.plain: In your Command phase, one other model in this model's unit gets back all of its lost wounds.

3a92d4cc0439.name: Wrath of the Wronged
3a92d4cc0439.plain: In your Shooting phase when one of your ARCANA ASTARTES INFANTRY units is chosen to shoot, or in the Fight phase when one is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of each attack made by a model in that unit.

3aeed7bed3c6.name: Touched by Tzeentch
3aeed7bed3c6.plain:
- Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
- Whenever a model in this unit would lose a wound because of a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 5+ the wound isn't lost.
- When the first battle round starts, before either player takes a turn, this unit's models may each make a Normal Move of up to 6", but can't end it within 9" of any enemy models. When both players have units able to do this, whoever takes the first turn moves their models first.

3c3b61b0516b.name: The Blade of Magnus
3c3b61b0516b.plain: Each time the bearer has fought, pick one enemy model that lost wounds to attacks made with this weapon but survived. That model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

3cc089ae3ab3.name: Scarab Occult Sorcerer
3cc089ae3ab3.plain: This model knows Smite and one power from either the Discipline of Change or the Discipline of Vengeance.

3e5cd41a315f.name: Malicious Volleys

40c7028a4abe.name: Disc of Tzeentch
40c7028a4abe.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 12". It gains the FLY and CAVALRY keywords and loses the INFANTRY keyword.

40dc77629182.name: Biomechanical Mutation
40dc77629182.plain: In any phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE models would lose a wound to a mortal wound: for the rest of the phase, whenever that model would lose a wound because of a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ the wound isn't lost.

44af8fda5cab.name: Malevolent Machine Spirit
44af8fda5cab.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your THOUSAND SONS MACHINE SPIRIT models. Until your next Command phase starts, when working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat that model as having all of its wounds remaining.

45729e08033d.name: Warped Regeneration
45729e08033d.plain: In your Psychic phase, after a THOUSAND SONS unit from your army manifests a psychic power with an unmodified Psychic test of 9 or more: if a model in that unit has lost any wounds, that model is healed and gets back up to D3 lost wounds (a model can only be healed once per turn). If not, and any models from that unit have been destroyed, you can bring one of them back to the battlefield in unit coherency with all of its wounds.

458ec92b0f0f.name: Seer's Bane
458ec92b0f0f.plain: Only a model with a force sword or Prosperine khopesh can take this. It takes the place of that model's force sword or Prosperine khopesh.

4812cd8dbf36.name: Bladed Maelstrom
4812cd8dbf36.plain: If this pact succeeds, pick an enemy unit within 30" of this INFERNAL MASTER that it can see: it suffers 1 mortal wound if it has 6 or more models. Also, until your next Command phase starts, subtract 2 from that unit's Advance and charge rolls.

48172b83f91c.name: Umbralefic Crystal
48172b83f91c.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, you may redeploy the bearer or one of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units within 6" of it later that turn. Remove it from the battlefield, then in the Reinforcements step of that turn's Movement phase, set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

494110f1f313.name: Time Flux
494110f1f313.plain: Blessing: when manifested, pick one of your CULT OF TIME INFANTRY units within 6" of this PSYKER. You can bring one destroyed model from that unit back to the battlefield in unit coherency, with all of its wounds.

496e2f2208c9.name: Weaver of Fates
496e2f2208c9.plain: Blessing: the models in one THOUSAND SONS unit within 18" of this PSYKER have a 4+ invulnerable save until your next Psychic phase starts.

4c64a6e61bac.name: Reality Unbound
4c64a6e61bac.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your WARPMELD PACT TZAANGOR ENLIGHTENED units is chosen to shoot or fight: for the rest of the phase, attacks made by models in that unit with a fatecaster greatbow or divining spear have their Armour Penetration improved by 2.

555be0f8660d.name: Oraculae Brazier
555be0f8660d.plain: In your Command phase, one CULT OF PROPHECY CORE or CULT OF PROPHECY CHARACTER unit near the bearer gains limited re-rolls until your next Command phase. Pick one of the CULT OF PROPHECY CORE or CULT OF PROPHECY CHARACTER units within 6" of the bearer. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever that unit shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its hit rolls, one of its wound rolls and one of its damage rolls.

564a9fa14cfb.name: Divine the Future
564a9fa14cfb.plain: Blessing: when manifested, roll one D6 and put it aside. Until your next Psychic phase starts, you can use that roll in place of any single dice rolled for a CULT OF PROPHECY unit from your army, as long as the dice is for one of these: a hit, wound, Advance or charge roll; a Psychic test; a Deny the Witch test; or a Morale test.

576e72bf4421.name: Tzaangor Onslaught
576e72bf4421.plain: In the Fight phase: pick one of your WARPMELD PACT BRAY units. For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit piles in or consolidates, it can move up to 3" further.

57a51dadad1e.name: Inhuman Savagery
57a51dadad1e.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your TZAANGOR units is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll the hit roll for melee attacks made by models in that unit.

58bde68c4cfc.name: Smite (Magnus)
58bde68c4cfc.plain: If manifested, the closest enemy unit that is visible to the psyker and within 18" of it takes D6 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result was more than 11, the target takes 3D3 mortal wounds instead.

5a559340fa21.name: Loyal Thrall
5a559340fa21.plain: This model can attempt a psychic action in place of one attempt to manifest a psychic power, rather than in place of all of them.

5abf2c7a8c55.name: Mere Servants

5accfa497ae8.name: Protégé
5accfa497ae8.plain: This model knows one extra psychic power from any discipline available to it.

5caa99637b40.name: Soul Reap
5caa99637b40.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS units is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, soulreaper cannons carried by models in that unit gain this ability: "When an attack is made with this weapon against a unit of 11 or more models, make 2 hit rolls for it instead of 1."

5ea99e4f1f78.name: Psychic Stalk
5ea99e4f1f78.plain: Witchfire: one enemy unit (not a VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER) within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see loses a model if 2D6 beats its unmodified Leadership. Roll 2D6: if the total is higher than that unit's unmodified Leadership characteristic, your opponent chooses one model in it and that model is slain.

6010d3552288.name: Thousand Sons Daemon Prince
6010d3552288.plain: This model knows Smite plus two powers from the Discipline of Change, the Discipline of Vengeance, or a mix of both.

6067aae8a6fa.name: Dysmanifestation
6067aae8a6fa.plain: Malediction: when manifested, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, take 1 off that unit's Leadership and Attacks characteristics.

60f92bd06131.name: Coruscator
60f92bd06131.plain: Only a model with an inferno bolt pistol can take this. It replaces that model's inferno bolt pistol.

614ad19ab72e.name: Seeker After Shadows
614ad19ab72e.plain: When this WARLORD attempts a Psychic action, roll one extra D6 for its Psychic test and discard one D6. If your army is a Cabal of Sorcerers, you also get 1 extra Cabal point whenever you generate Cabal points while this WARLORD is on the battlefield.

633d1587e71b.name: Presage
633d1587e71b.plain: Blessing: if manifested, pick one of your THOUSAND SONS units within 18" of this PSYKER to add 1 to its hit rolls until your next Psychic phase starts.

665d01afbaef.name: Sorcerous Might
665d01afbaef.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS SORCERER or THOUSAND SONS EXALTED SORCERER units with a force stave (not a Relic) is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, that force stave's Damage characteristic becomes D3+1.

673cc856ff48.name: Aspiring Sorcerer
673cc856ff48.plain: This model knows Smite and one power from either the Discipline of Change or the Discipline of Vengeance.

686f87e08f26.name: Aetheric Saturation
686f87e08f26.plain: In your Psychic phase, when a PSYKER CHARACTER of yours that is within 12" of one of your MUTALITH VORTEX BEAST models is chosen to manifest psychic powers: instead of manifesting one psychic power, that model is healed and gets back up to D3 lost wounds. A model can only be healed once per turn.

68c58cd98e2c.name: Warp Explosion
68c58cd98e2c.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before you take it off the battlefield. It explodes on a 4+: every unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

693b11d90ebc.name: Infernal Master
693b11d90ebc.plain: This model knows two of the Infernal Pacts. In your Command phase, while it is on the battlefield, it can try to make one pact it knows, as long as no friendly model has already tried that pact this battle round. Roll one D6: on a 3+, the pact succeeds.

6d08f78466ce.name: Ardent Automata
6d08f78466ce.plain: While this model's unit is performing an action, it can shoot and the action does not fail.

6dbd8fc9155e.name: Malefic Scroll
6dbd8fc9155e.plain: In your Psychic phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units, other than MAGNUS THE RED, manifests Smite: that Smite inflicts 3 mortal wounds instead of D3 or D6, with no dice rolled.

739fafd0bcfd.name: Infernal Master
739fafd0bcfd.plain: This model knows Smite and one power from either the Discipline of Change or the Discipline of Vengeance.

7637f85ed43f.name: Jealous Tyrant
7637f85ed43f.plain: Each THOUSAND SONS Detachment in your army can include no more than one DAEMON PRINCE unit.

78f0348e6b21.name: Twisted Mirage
78f0348e6b21.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase, when one of your WARPMELD PACT PSYKER CHARACTER units is chosen as a charge target: if no enemy units are within Engagement Range of it, it can make a Normal Move of up to 6". For the rest of the phase, it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. Your opponent can then pick new targets for that charge.

792d7afae7d2.name: Sorcerous Arcana
792d7afae7d2.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the THOUSAND SONS keyword: give one THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model in your army one Sorcerous Arcana Relic it is allowed to have. Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't give a model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

7a9634ed75dc.name: Fated Mutation
7a9634ed75dc.plain: Whenever this unit is chosen to fight, you don't roll for its Mutated Beyond Reason ability. Instead, choose which result applies for that fight.

7d9fdc74a0e1.name: Warpflame Gargoyles
7d9fdc74a0e1.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your ARCANA ASTARTES VEHICLE models, other than HELBRUTEs. For every other unit within Engagement Range of it, roll one D6, subtracting 2 when rolling for a CHARACTER or VEHICLE unit. Each unit that rolls a 4+ suffers D3 mortal wounds.

7ecf7e1f1335.name: Sorthis' Mirror
7ecf7e1f1335.plain: Each time the bearer is chosen to fight, you can turn one nearby enemy INFANTRY model against its own unit instead of fighting. The model must be within Engagement Range of the bearer and have a Leadership characteristic of 9 or less. It immediately attacks its own unit in melee, and until those attacks are resolved it counts as one of your models for all rules purposes. If the model wipes out its own unit this way, that unit counts as destroyed by the bearer for all rules purposes.

7fe5b093f5b3.name: Perplex
7fe5b093f5b3.plain: Malediction: until your next Psychic phase starts, one enemy unit within 24" of this PSYKER can't target units more than 24" away with ranged attacks.

8297e88e12f7.name: Temporal Manipulation
8297e88e12f7.plain: Blessing: one of your THOUSAND SONS models within 12" of this PSYKER, other than VEHICLES, is healed and gets back up to D3 lost wounds. A model can only be healed once per turn.

836372ab1d9a.name: Exalted Mutation
836372ab1d9a.plain: Increase the bearer's Strength, Toughness and Attacks characteristics by 1 each.

83a6978a3d3f.name: Grand Schemer (Aura)
83a6978a3d3f.plain: Aura: while within 3" of this WARLORD, your CULT OF SCHEMING units gain Objective Secured. If such a unit already has Objective Secured, each of its models counts as 2 models when working out who controls objective markers.

83f9e9b166ff.name: Skaeloch's Talon
83f9e9b166ff.plain: Only a model that has a force stave can take this Relic, and it takes the place of a force stave.

845dcc399b69.name: Vengeance for Prospero
845dcc399b69.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS units is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit attacks a SPACE WOLVES unit in melee, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

8739908dd5a4.name: High Acolytes
8739908dd5a4.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the THOUSAND SONS keyword: pick one ARCANA ASTARTES CHARACTER model in your army (not a named character) and give it one Warlord Trait it is allowed to have. That model only counts as your WARLORD for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (re-roll duplicates if rolling randomly), and this Stratagem can't give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

8842b207ed85.name: Arrogance of Aeons
8842b207ed85.plain: You can re-roll this WARLORD's Deny the Witch tests, and in a Cabal of Sorcerers army it can benefit from one extra Cabbalistic Ritual per Psychic phase.

893e547a0117.name: Devastating Sorcery
893e547a0117.plain: Once per Psychic phase, you can re-roll the Psychic test when this WARLORD tries to manifest Smite or a Witchfire power.

8b5ad6b39f79.name: Inescapable Forewarning
8b5ad6b39f79.plain: Use this at the end of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase, if any enemy unit arrived as Reinforcements within 18" of one of your ARCANA ASTARTES PSYKER units. Pick one of your ARCANA ASTARTES CORE units within 6" of that ARCANA ASTARTES PSYKER unit that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When it does, its models can only target one eligible enemy unit that arrived as Reinforcements this turn within 18" of both their own unit and that ARCANA ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

8c37bc28185f.name: Warpweave Mantle
8c37bc28185f.plain: Any charge that targets the bearer fails on an unmodified charge roll of 9+, and while the bearer has lost any wounds, add 1 to its Psychic tests.

8f878fc30818.name: Unholy Susurrus
8f878fc30818.plain: At the start of your Psychic phase: pick one THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army and one psychic power from a discipline it has access to. That power takes the place of one psychic power the unit already knows.

8fb4bfb49303.name: Diabolic Savant
8fb4bfb49303.plain: If this pact succeeds, you can re-roll this INFERNAL MASTER's Psychic tests in your next Psychic phase. A Cabal of Sorcerers army also generates one extra Cabal point at the start of that phase.

92d874a670f5.name: Unearthly Power
92d874a670f5.plain: You can re-roll Psychic tests taken for this model. Add 1 to every Psychic test and Deny the Witch test taken for this model, or add 2 instead while it has 10 or more wounds remaining.

930e2c0207f4.name: Implacable Guardians
930e2c0207f4.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one of your ARCANA ASTARTES CHARACTER models, other than MAGNUS THE RED. For the rest of the phase, it can use the Look Out, Sir rule while it is within 3" of any of your RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS units, even when this unit has fewer than 3 models.

94534fb62093.name: Explodes (D6")
94534fb62093.plain: When this model is destroyed, before removing it from play and before any models embarked inside it disembark, roll one D6. On a 6 it explodes: every unit within D6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

94f6081cd166.name: Fated Mutation
94f6081cd166.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS CHAOS SPAWN units is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, you can choose the result of that unit's Mutated Beyond Reason ability instead of rolling for it, and add 1 whenever you work out how many Attacks a model in that unit makes.

95a2e7634600.name: Tzaangor Shaman
95a2e7634600.plain: This model knows Smite and one power from the Discipline of Change.

96365e7f5c35.name: Sorcerous Facade
96365e7f5c35.plain: Blessing: when manifested, pick one of your CULT OF DUPLICITY INFANTRY or CULT OF DUPLICITY MONSTER units within 6" of this PSYKER. Take that unit off the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

96666d4580d6.name: Thrall
96666d4580d6.plain: For every <GREAT CULT> EXALTED SORCERER unit in a Detachment, you can add one <GREAT CULT> SORCERER unit to that Detachment that does not use up a Battlefield Role slot.

972d6edf76fa.name: Guided by the Whispers
972d6edf76fa.plain: Once per turn, when this WARLORD is chosen as a charge target, it can make a Normal Move of up to 6" after any Overwatch is fired but before the charge roll.

97f6987cfd1e.name: Heldrake claws
97f6987cfd1e.plain: Attacks from this weapon have Damage 4 when they are allocated to an AIRCRAFT.

99a6663a85a5.name: Fickle Nature
99a6663a85a5.plain: You can re-roll this WARLORD's charge rolls, and it can shoot and declare a charge even in a turn when it Fell Back.

9b2bc2b0bf18.name: Webway Infiltration
9b2bc2b0bf18.plain: Once per battle, during deployment: if you spend 2CP, you can place one of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units in the webway rather than on the battlefield. If you spend 3CP, you can place two of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units there instead. Each of those units can then be set up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

9d4b488e56c6.name: Tzeentch's Firestorm
9d4b488e56c6.plain: Witchfire: roll nine D6 for one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see; it suffers 1 mortal wound for each 6. If the Psychic test was an unmodified 9+, it suffers 1 mortal wound for each 5+ instead.

9d813b608f45.name: Sorcerer in Terminator Armour
9d813b608f45.plain: This model knows Smite plus two powers from the Dark Hereticus discipline, the Discipline of Change, or a mix of both.

9ee0c27e9b8a.name: Arcane Focus
9ee0c27e9b8a.plain: In a Cabal of Sorcerers army, Cabbalistic Rituals cost one fewer Cabal point when used on one of your CULT OF MAGIC PSYKER units near the bearer. At the start of your Psychic phase, pick one of your CULT OF MAGIC PSYKER units within 6" of the bearer. Until that phase ends, every Cabbalistic Ritual you use on that unit costs one fewer Cabal point.

a364af3ac3fe.name: Immaterial Echo
a364af3ac3fe.plain: In your Psychic phase, if this WARLORD gets a Psychic test result of 9+ when manifesting a power, it can try to manifest one extra psychic power that phase. If it passes the Psychic test for that extra power, the power can't be denied. This Warlord Trait gives it no more than one extra power per phase.

a6480846e575.name: Coruscating Beam
a6480846e575.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your THOUSAND SONS WARLORD is on the battlefield: pick a point on the battlefield and put a marker there. At the start of your next Command phase, put a second marker within 9" of the centre of the first, and draw a line between the centres of the two markers. Roll one D6 for each unit the line passes over or through; add 1 if that unit has 11 or more models, and subtract 1 if it is a CHARACTER. Each unit that rolls a 4+ suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then remove the markers.

a6d20371f488.name: Swelled by the Warp
a6d20371f488.plain: Blessing: one of your THOUSAND SONS models within 12" of this PSYKER adds 2 to its Strength and 1 to its Attacks until your next Psychic phase starts.

a7a99499dc70.name: Baleful Devolution
a7a99499dc70.plain: Witchfire: one enemy unit of 6 or more models within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see suffers D3 mortal wounds for each 6 you roll. Roll as many D6 as the result of the Psychic test.

ab179d2d4b28.name: Glamour of Tzeentch
ab179d2d4b28.plain: Blessing: until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks against one of your THOUSAND SONS units within 18" of this PSYKER.

abcc51f33a84.name: Helbrute fist
abcc51f33a84.plain: When the bearer fights, if it has 2 Helbrute fists, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon.

acd431ce0e0d.name: The Stave Abominus
acd431ce0e0d.plain: Only a model with a force stave can take this. It replaces that model's force stave.

afe191a09401.name: Ensorcelled Infusion
afe191a09401.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE models that is within 6" of one of your ARCANA ASTARTES PSYKER units is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration of that model's ranged weapons by 1.

aff924680577.name: Pyric Flux
aff924680577.plain: Blessing: one of your ARCANA ASTARTES units within 12" of this PSYKER adds 1 to the Strength of its warpflame weapons until the end of the turn. This means the warpflamers, warpflame pistols and heavy warpflamers carried by models in that unit, and any relics that replace one of them.

b2b3ebce7394.name: Gaze of Hate
b2b3ebce7394.plain: Witchfire: roll three D6 for one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see; it suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+.

b5254a2b202d.name: Battle-psyker
b5254a2b202d.plain: This model's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill become 2+, and its Attacks characteristic becomes 5.

b65c97611000.name: Fatecaster greatbow
b65c97611000.plain: You can ignore the Look out, Sir! rule when choosing this weapon's target. Every attack made with this weapon, Overwatch included, is always successful on an unmodified hit roll of 2+.

b8d42cd3b782.name: Psychic Dominion
b8d42cd3b782.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units is chosen to try to deny a psychic power: as long as that unit is within 6" of another of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units that could also try to deny that power, roll one extra D6 for that Deny the Witch test.

b9573d918ab5.name: Lord of the Thousand Sons (Aura)
b9573d918ab5.plain: Aura: while one of your <GREAT CULT> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

b99a79ab213d.name: Otherworldly Prescience
b99a79ab213d.plain: Once per battle, before a saving throw is made for this WARLORD, you can give it a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the turn.

b9f4b72011e0.name: Fires of the Abyss
b9f4b72011e0.plain: If this pact succeeds, the nearest enemy unit within 15" of this INFERNAL MASTER that it can see suffers D3 mortal wounds.

ba1cfc3f2a69.name: Schemes of Change
ba1cfc3f2a69.plain: You can only use this Stratagem if every Detachment in your army is a THOUSAND SONS Detachment. Use it when playing a mission in which you pick secondary objectives or Agendas, once both players have revealed what they picked. You can swap one of your secondary objectives or Agendas for a different one; note your new choice on your army roster and tell your opponent. The usual rules for picking secondary objectives and Agendas still apply. If both players have a rule letting them pick new secondary objectives or Agendas, both make their new choices first and then reveal them to each other at the same time.

ba31361da985.name: The Chronos Tutorum
ba31361da985.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, this model can gain one extra Warlord Trait. It must be one the bearer is allowed to have, and every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly).

bb9e930fa882.name: Dark Blessing
bb9e930fa882.plain: Witchfire: roll one D6 for one enemy model within 6" of this PSYKER that it can see; if the roll beats its Toughness, its unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

be29caa0a41b.name: Malefic Maelstrom
be29caa0a41b.plain: If this pact succeeds, one of your THOUSAND SONS units within 24" of this INFERNAL MASTER that it can see gets 1 extra Strength on its ranged attacks. This lasts until your next Command phase starts.

be3e6a014e3f.name: The Change-wrought Chalice
be3e6a014e3f.plain: The bearer knows one extra psychic power, chosen from the Discipline of Change or the Discipline of Vengeance.

c1ae467cd105.name: Aetherstride
c1ae467cd105.plain: This WARLORD gets 3" more Move and can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. It also moves as if it can FLY whenever it makes a Normal Move, an Advance, a charge move or Falls Back.

c1fd74c87514.name: Pentakairic Armour
c1fd74c87514.plain: This model knows one extra pact, and once per turn, the first time the bearer fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

c221e2d6971a.name: Exalted Sorcerer
c221e2d6971a.plain: This model knows Smite plus two powers from the Discipline of Change, the Discipline of Vengeance, or a mix of both.

c27fc30133e6.name: Masters of the Immaterium
c27fc30133e6.plain: In your Psychic phase, when one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units would suffer Perils of the Warp: it doesn't suffer it.

c2d982fc3569.name: Manipulator of Reality
c2d982fc3569.plain: When the first battle round starts, you can pick up to 3 of your TZAANGOR units and set them up again wholly within your deployment zone. Do this after any of your units have made Normal Moves granted by Touched by Tzeentch: take the chosen units off the battlefield, then place them anywhere on the battlefield wholly within your deployment zone. If the mission uses Strategic Reserves, you can put any of those units into Strategic Reserves instead, at no extra CP cost and no matter how many units are already there.

c8bb2f865e69.name: Great Sorcerer
c8bb2f865e69.plain: In your Psychic phase: pick one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models. That unit can try to manifest one extra psychic power this turn.

cb9f7163a946.name: Warpmeld Spawn
cb9f7163a946.plain:
Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one WARPMELD PACT CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.
- Models in that unit add 1 to their Strength characteristic.
- Models in that unit add 1 to their Toughness characteristic.

cbf755123961.name: Crown of the Crimson King
cbf755123961.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, and it never suffers Perils of the Warp.

ceadfda746ed.name: Empyric Guidance
ceadfda746ed.plain: Blessing: until your next Psychic phase starts, Rapid Fire and Heavy weapons in one of your THOUSAND SONS units within 12" of this PSYKER get 6" more range.

ceffc46c0cb8.name: Diamond of Distortion
ceffc46c0cb8.plain: In your Command phase, give one of your WARPMELD PACT TZAANGOR or WARPMELD PACT CHAOS SPAWN units within 9" of the bearer a 4+ invulnerable save. It lasts until your next Command phase starts.

d10005dcf06a.name: Teleport Strike
d10005dcf06a.plain: During deployment, you can put this model in a teleportarium chamber rather than on the battlefield. It can teleport in at the end of any of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

d157faf60c61.name: Touch of Vicissitude
d157faf60c61.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, each unmodified hit roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any other damage.

d22150e4d28e.name: Undying Form
d22150e4d28e.plain: Every attack allocated to this WARLORD has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.

d25160f3fa14.name: Brotherhood of Sorcerers
d25160f3fa14.plain:
If your army is Battle-forged, every THOUSAND SONS unit in a THOUSAND SONS Detachment gets these abilities:
- Add 1 to Psychic tests taken for the unit.
- If the unit is ARCANA ASTARTES or TZAANGOR, each of its models has a 5+ invulnerable save.

d255cc073ea1.name: Ardent Scholar
d255cc073ea1.plain: Whenever this WARLORD takes a Psychic test, you can re-roll any of its dice that show a 1.

d408efe0cfe2.name: Doombolt
d408efe0cfe2.plain: Witchfire: when manifested, the nearest enemy unit that is within 18" of this PSYKER and visible to it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

d997277747de.name: Empyric Reservoir
d997277747de.plain: At the start of your Psychic phase: pick one model from your army within 6" of one of your MUTALITH VORTEX BEAST models. If the chosen model generates Cabal points, it generates D3 extra Cabal points.

dbd2498bb6f6.name: Selfless Automata
dbd2498bb6f6.plain: In the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase: pick one enemy unit that ended a charge move within Engagement Range of any of your ARCANA ASTARTES CHARACTER units this phase. One of your RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS units can then perform a Heroic Intervention, if it is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. During it, each model in that unit may move up to 2D6" rather than 3", and it doesn't need to end any closer to the nearest enemy model. Instead, at least one model in the unit must end within Engagement Range of the chosen enemy unit, and no model in the unit can end within Engagement Range of any other enemy unit; if that isn't possible, the unit doesn't move.

dc30492e2db4.name: Incandeum (shooting)
dc30492e2db4.plain: Attacks made with this profile always hit the target automatically.

dc618412ed48.name: Capricious Chest
dc618412ed48.plain: Once per battle round, after any re-rolls, you can change dice in a Psychic test taken for a model within 18" of the bearer. For a model in your army, you can turn any dice result of 1 into a 6; for a model in your opponent's army, you can turn any dice result of 6 into a 1.

de067267b15f.name: Conniving Plate
de067267b15f.plain: The bearer has a 2+ Save, and an enemy model within Engagement Range of it can aim at most half its melee attacks (rounding up) at the bearer. That limit applies each time such a model picks targets in the Fight phase.

e00215f53243.name: Helm of the Daemon's Eye
e00215f53243.plain: Roll one D6 whenever your opponent uses a Stratagem, as long as the bearer is on the battlefield; on a 5+, you get 1 Command point.

e123948613a4.name: Beguiling Influence
e123948613a4.plain: Attacks made against this WARLORD can't re-roll their hit rolls, wound rolls or damage rolls.

e32941d9c32f.name: Ephemeral Existence
e32941d9c32f.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your WARPMELD PACT TZAANGOR units is chosen to move: until the end of the turn, whenever that unit makes a Normal Move, Advances, Falls Back or makes a charge move, its models can move horizontally through models and terrain features during that move. They can't end a move on top of another model or its base.

e36651fd65cb.name: Aura of Dark Glory
e36651fd65cb.plain: Every model in this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

e3ec6657a095.name: Seer's Bane
e3ec6657a095.plain: When this weapon attacks a PSYKER unit, its Strength characteristic is x2, and any of its attacks allocated to a PSYKER unit has Damage D6.

e46ac6e62bd9.name: Gaze of Magnus
e46ac6e62bd9.plain: When this model manifests Smite, it inflicts D6 mortal wounds instead of D3. If the Psychic test result was 11 or more, it inflicts 3D3 mortal wounds instead of D6.

e4b380e9963e.name: Thrydderghyre
e4b380e9963e.plain: In a turn in which it Fell Back, the bearer can still manifest psychic powers, and in a turn in which it Advanced, it can still declare a charge. When it consolidates, it can move up to 6", and the move doesn't have to finish closer to the nearest enemy model.

e68aff8c9fb3.name: Aspiring Magister
e68aff8c9fb3.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one THOUSAND SONS Aspiring Sorcerer or THOUSAND SONS Scarab Occult Sorcerer model in your army. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER, that model can take one of these Sorcerous Arcana Relics: Coruscator, Skaeloch's Talon, Incandaeum or The Stave Abominus. Every Relic in your army must be unique and on a different model.

e6e1e034edf3.name: Gift of Change
e6e1e034edf3.plain: Once per battle, in your Psychic phase, when an enemy CHARACTER unit is destroyed: put a new WARPMELD PACT CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army onto the battlefield, within 6" of the destroyed unit but not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. This new CHAOS SPAWN unit has just 1 model, and in a game using a points limit it costs no Reinforcement points. In a Crusade game, the CHAOS SPAWN unit is not added to your Order of Battle when the battle ends.

e73c7fdbcc4a.name: Attempted Possession
e73c7fdbcc4a.plain: Malediction: when manifested, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. It suffers 1 mortal wound. Also, until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 2 from every Psychic test taken for that unit.

e7a7d4497159.name: The Prism of Echoes
e7a7d4497159.plain: Whenever the bearer manifests a Blessing psychic power, the first range listed in that power's effects is doubled.

e8c8fdd427b9.name: Witch-warrior
e8c8fdd427b9.plain: Whenever this model manifests Smite, or a Witchfire power that rolls dice to set its number of mortal wounds, you can re-roll one of those dice. For example, the roll might be D3, or one D6 for each model in the unit.

ebf99e12a76a.name: Cha'Qi'Thl's Theorem
ebf99e12a76a.plain: Once per battle, while the bearer is on the battlefield, you can make one Thousand Sons Stratagem cost 0 Command points. You can do this in any phase; the reduced cost lasts until you have used that Stratagem or the phase ends, whichever happens first.

ec540fbfd8bf.name: Empyric Trespass
ec540fbfd8bf.plain: Malediction: when manifested, pick an enemy unit within 24" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, when a model in one of your CULT OF KNOWLEDGE units attacks that enemy unit, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

ed01e47561f2.name: Malignant Pact
ed01e47561f2.plain: In your Command phase, when one of your INFERNAL MASTER models fails to make a pact: pick one of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY or THOUSAND SONS CAVALRY units within 6" of that model. The pact succeeds, but that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

eef21b965c13.name: Dilettante
eef21b965c13.plain: This model can take one extra Sorcerous Arcana relic, even if it already has a Relic. The relic must be one this model is allowed to have, and every Relic in your army must be different.

f35690aaff76.name: Glimpse of Eternity
f35690aaff76.plain: If this pact succeeds, you can re-roll one dice you roll before the start of your next Command phase. You can't use it to re-roll a roll related to the mission.

f57990d4e2ae.name: Vector Strike
f57990d4e2ae.plain: In your Movement phase, after one of your THOUSAND SONS HELDRAKE models makes a Normal Move: pick one enemy unit it moved across, other than a CHARACTER with a Wounds characteristic of 9 or less. Roll one D6; on a 2+ the enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, or 3 mortal wounds instead if it can FLY.

f58a066cf431.name: Infernal Fusillade
f58a066cf431.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your ARCANA ASTARTES INFANTRY units is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit shoots a bolt weapon, it makes one extra attack with it. For example, a model firing an inferno combi-bolter at a target within half range makes 5 attacks.

f6222ea64573.name: Lord of the Thousand Sons (Aura) - Ahriman
f6222ea64573.plain: Aura: while one of your THOUSAND SONS CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

f9758eb1c7e3.name: Astral Blast
f9758eb1c7e3.plain: Witchfire: when manifested, the nearest enemy unit that is within 12" of this PSYKER and visible to it suffers D3 mortal wounds, and every other unit within 3" of that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

f9c8409e9d44.name: Bestial Prophet (Aura)
f9c8409e9d44.plain: Aura: while one of your BRAY or ENLIGHTENED units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in that unit.

fa5624c828e5.name: Athenaean Scrolls
fa5624c828e5.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can pick one power it knows, and for the rest of the battle its Psychic tests for that power roll one extra D6 and discard one D6. Do this in your Psychic phase, when the bearer is chosen to manifest psychic powers; the power must be a Discipline of Change or Discipline of Vengeance power.

fc3db8ebb389.name: Cacodaemonic Curse
fc3db8ebb389.plain: Malediction: subtract 1 from the Strength of ranged weapons in one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER until your next Psychic phase starts.

fce34b7b8b9f.name: Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers
fce34b7b8b9f.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your THOUSAND SONS CORE or THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, you can re-roll the hit roll for attacks made by models in that unit.

fe9d403a06f5.name: Ahriman
fe9d403a06f5.plain: This model knows Smite, plus three powers chosen from the Discipline of Change, the Discipline of Vengeance, or both.
